description: This file defines the PimCsvDataImport class responsible for importing employee data from CSV format into the system. It handles validation, mapping, and saving employee records, including parsing personal details, contact information, and related entities like nationality and location.
external_methods: validate() // from Email and Phone rules

classes.name: PimCsvDataImport
classes.description: Handles importing employee data from CSV format, including data validation, entity mapping, and database persistence. Extends CsvDataImport and utilizes multiple traits for logging, service access, and text helpers.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Main method to import employee data from an array, including validation, entity creation, and saving.

methods.name: getDateTimeIfValid
methods.description: Parses a date string into a DateTime object if valid, else returns null.

methods.name: getNationalityIfValid
methods.description: Retrieves a Nationality entity based on a name if valid.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the NationalityService.

methods.name: getCountryCodeIfValid
methods.description: Returns the country code for a valid country name.

methods.name: getCountryService
methods.description: Retrieves the CountryService via dependency container.

methods.name: getProvinceIfValid
methods.description: Returns the province code for a valid province name within the country.

methods.name: isValidPhoneNumber
methods.description: Validates a phone number string using Phone rule.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Validates an email string using Email rule.

methods.name: isUniqueEmail
methods.description: Checks if an email is unique in the system.

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Checks if an employee ID is unique.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string is null or empty.
